notes.title: Engineering Update
notes.notes:
It is no longer in alpha. The game is stable and offers many hours of gameplay.
Thank you all for your contributions — whether through bug reporting, translations, or sharing your ideas and proposals.
Your support has been invaluable to the development of the game.

-Added creative mode.
-Added buffs system.
-Added a new NPC Engineer (will come to the village the next day if there are blacksmiths and farmers).
-Added speed buff (increase moving speed).
-Added drunk buff (reduce incoming damage).
-Added work buff (Increases item creation rate and reduces required stamina).
-Added fishing buff (Increases efficiency of fishing rods).
-Added sated buff (recover stamina while moving).
-Added speed potion.
-Added work potion.
-Added fishing potion.
-Added mining drill.
-Added signal cable.
-Added lever.
-Added pressure plate.
-Added signal lamp.
-Added signal bridge.
-Added signal repeater.
-Added signal inverter.
-Added diode.
-Added transistor.
-Added light detector.
-Added music box.
-Added solar panel.
-Added iron electric pole.
-Added iron electric lamp.
-Added chests rack.
-Added Engineer's handbook.
-Added sort button to inventories.
-Added take all button to inventories.
-Added the drunk effect.
-Added totems around the world.
-Now good food will apply sated buff.
-Improved UI scaling on ultrawide scrrens.
-Added hints about electricity consumption and production in the building menu.
-Added descriptions to some items.
-Improved inventory sorting algoritm.
-Increased golden coin stack size to 9999.
-Unresearched buildings now will show required scroll to research instead of building resources.

-Fixed bug when can't load game after going to main menu.
-Fixed bug when bossHP panel does not hide after killing boss.
-Fixed bug when a big stone pile can occasionally disappear.
-Fixed bug when mushroom does not spawn.
-Fixed bug when after making cheese lost 1 bucket.

notes.title: Electricity update
notes.notes:
Dear players!

I'm excited to introduce you to an update that brings new mechanics to the game, namely electricity and automation.
Now you have the opportunity to create a power grid and connect automatic machines to it.
Also, the wooden bridge can now be repaired and access to the new area.

Game improvements

Removed shadow casting from dynamic light sources such as a floor lamp due to serious performance issues.
Removing buildings now returns all spent resources
Reworked the handling of the black area of ​​the minimap to improve performance significantly.

notes.title: Alpha 0.1.7 Ravens Update
notes.notes:
New Features

Add Ravens, now you can meet ravens in the forest, ravens have a chance to drop random seeds, also ravens have a chance to eat your crops on garden cells. You can use scarecrows to prevent it.
Add seeds extractor, new work station, extracts seeds from plants

Building Removed

Removed Shop due to new raven mechanic, now you can get seeds from ravens or extract them from plants in seed extractor.

Bug fixes

Fixed bug when item crafting take double stamina
Fixed bug when remove resources only from one stack and place 99 in craft
Fixed bug when picking mushroom broke interaction indicator
